reviewed_finding: No operation candidate was recovered, so the declarations were mined by hand: Paper.lean line 54 (old_image_injective, a general theorem over arbitrary types A B E) and Paper001.lean lines 103 (E = Unit), 111, 128, 138. The injectivity theorem is general and non-vacuous. The three negative-boundary theorems are fixed Fin instances (off_image_not_implied: u constant 0 and r constant inl 0 on Fin 1 -> Fin 2; observation_not_implied: identity on Fin 2; repair_not_implied: the constant-true predicate on Fin 1), and repair_not_implied states only that a constant-true predicate stays true, so it defines no repair. This node proves the general forms of the first two boundaries, a converse and an exact count, keeps the repair statement at the weak persistence reading, and enumerates all (u, r) pairs for small finite sets to see that the claim could fail on them.

claim_boundary.supports: Kernel-checked (types in Type): for arbitrary A, B, E the old-image law r(u a) = inl a implies u injective, hence |A| <= |B| when finite; for arbitrary A, B and E = Unit every injective lift has a law-satisfying recovery r : B -> A + Unit (injective_iff_exists_law; with E empty the converse fails when A is empty and B is not); for injective u the law can be extended by any single value x : A + E at all off-image points (law_freedom_off_image; the independent free value at each off-image point is the content of law_card), so for an off-image point and an old term a0 there are two law-satisfying recoveries, one refusing and one accepting it (off_image_not_implied_general); for any lift u and recovery r, with A nonempty and two distinct observation values, there are observations q, q2 with q2 after u different from q (observation_not_implied_general; the law hypothesis is not used), while q := q2 after u preserves observations on the same lift (observation_preserved_possible), so observation preservation is an extra condition the law neither implies nor excludes; the identity lift satisfies the law while leaving every predicate on the old terms unchanged (repair_not_implied_general, a persistence statement for the identity lift only); for finite A, B and injective u the number of law-satisfying recoveries into A + Unit is (|A|+1)^(|B|-|A|) (law_card). The three source negative boundaries are fixed Fin instances and are reproduced as such. Native: exhaustive enumeration of all (u, r) pairs for eleven (|A|,|B|,|O|) cases with |A|,|B| <= 4: the number of law pairs, none with a non-injective lift, the number that refuse every off-image point (one per injective lift) and those that do not, observation pairs preserved, and obstruction pairs that persist or clear, all exact integers. Column definitions: persists = number of (law pair, oA, oB) with some a such that oA a and oB (u a); cleared = number with oA nonempty and no such a; these are counting conventions, not a repair notion. obs_preserved, persists and cleared are the law-pair count times a factor independent of r, so they carry no information about the law; the Lean statements carry that claim. The agreement of the producer enumeration with the checker closed forms is the independent evidence, not either alone.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: Off-image rejection as a property of the S(n) retraction (that is PG-SN-OFF-IMAGE-REFUSAL, which needs an added soundness hypothesis on r); the pinned SnCarrier lift and retraction; any definition of obstruction repair beyond persistence of a Boolean predicate through a lift (the source repair_not_implied instance uses the constant-true predicate and defines no repair); sets with more than four elements in the native census (the Lean count law_card is general for finite types); infinite types for the count; any physical or categorical reading.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: A recovery r : B -> A + Unit obeying r(u a) = inl a exists exactly when u is injective. For an injective lift it is determined only on the image: there are (|A|+1)^(|B|-|A|) of them, exactly one of which refuses every off-image point; when |A| >= 1 and |B| > |A| the others accept some off-image point as an old term, and for |B| = |A| or |A| = 0 the recovery is unique. The law fixes neither observations nor obstruction predicates (persistence through the identity lift only).
claim_boundary.next_test: Define repair of an obstruction for a lift (a witness-count or chain criterion on the lifted pair) and decide for the identity embedding and for a non-identity injective lift whether the old obstruction count strictly drops, replacing the constant-predicate instance of repair_not_implied by a statement with a stated repair criterion.

additional_scope_clarifications.reviewed_target_qualification: The injectivity statement is general; off-image rejection and observation preservation are shown not to follow for all types, while the source repair_not_implied is a constant-predicate instance and does not define repair, so only persistence of a predicate through a lift is shown.
additional_scope_clarifications.historical_target_status: Original target retained verbatim as source history; the corrected narrow scope governs this run.

second_review.notes: Cold read of runs/20261021T175809Z_staged (p0 profile, p1 candidate, check_candidate.py, semantic_mutants.py, p2/p4 host_check), lean4/OldImageInjective.lean (sha256 4f260c7c identical to p1/construction), the Python producer and the DAG node, formed before opening the earlier pass. Statement fidelity: old_image_injective is general over A B E; injective_iff_exists_law is E = Unit only and the supports sentence now says so, including the E-empty counterexample; law_freedom_off_image gives a single constant value x off the image (supports now says so, and assigns per-point freedom to law_card); off_image_not_implied_general needs b0 off the image, a0 : A and e : E and is correctly described; observation_not_implied_general indeed ignores the law (_h unused) and needs Nonempty A and o0 <> o1, and the companion observation_preserved_possible is now an anchor (profile anchors and p2_checks.lean.anchors both carry it); repair_not_implied_general is Iff.rfl for the identity lift and is described as persistence for the identity lift only; law_card is the Nat.card of the subtype for injective u between Fintypes, equal to (|A|+1)^(|B|-|A|); I re-derived the bijection with functions on the off-image subtype and it matches the proof. Earlier-pass amendments: (a) all applied in the final text. The E = Unit scope, the per-point freedom wording, the observation clause with observation_preserved_possible, the identity-lift-only repair wording, the column definitions (persists / cleared / obs_preserved defined, and flagged as law-count times an r-independent factor), the narrowest_claim wording (|A|>=1 and |B|>|A| for non-refusing recoveries; unique for |B|=|A| or |A|=0), the composition_tree (only typed_recovery(lift(a))), the generator hypotheses (Types A B E, finite only for counting) and the four missing mutants (refusal-summand count, surjective-lift, empty-source observation, non-refusing recovery of a bijection) are all present. (b) The rebuild did not weaken the checker: check_candidate.py is pure closed forms (falling factorial times (a+1)^(b-a); persists = law * 2^(b-a) (4^a - 3^a); cleared = law * (3^a 2^(b-a) - 2^b); obs_preserved = law * o^b; pairs_total = b^a (a+1)^b), I recomputed each by hand and against the (2,3,2), (3,4,2) rows (18, 96, 252, 180). The only constants are law_noninjective = 0 (the injectivity theorem) and the input triple, which is matched as a multiset against the public cases. All 277 coordinate mutants and 11 semantic mutants are rejected, the reverse-order control is accepted, and the semantic mutants are real misreadings (the 12-of-18 non-refusing recoveries, the 18 law pairs over 6 lifts, the bijective-lift case), not flipped flags. (c) What I add that the earlier pass did not record: the strongest remaining issue is that narrowest_claim states, for all finite A and B, that 'exactly one of [the (|A|+1)^(|B|-|A|) recoveries] refuses every off-image point'. No Lean anchor states this uniqueness (law_freedom_off_image is existence with a constant extension; law_card is a count that does not single out the refusing element), and the checker establishes it only as the closed form law_refusing = injective_u, tested against a census with |A|,|B| <= 4. The sentence is true and immediate (the law fixes the image values and 'refuse everywhere off the image' fixes the rest), so I do not regard it as a rebuild defect, but it sits in the narrowest claim as a universal statement with only census-level support and should carry that qualification in the DAG text. Second, the census is weaker evidence than it looks: apart from law, law_refusing and law_nonrefusing, every other column (obs_total, obs_preserved, persists, cleared) is law-count times a factor in (a, b, o) independent of r, so exact agreement of those columns with the closed forms tests the producer's enumeration and not the law; the profile says this, correctly. Third, repair: the DAG statement says 'obstruction repair does not follow'; the kernel evidence is Iff.rfl for the identity lift, so the repair clause stays an instance-level persistence statement and is still an unpaid obligation (next_test), which is why the DAG text should be narrowed. Fourth, next_test (define repair and compare obstruction counts for identity and non-identity injective lifts) is the node's own obligation but is the discharge of the second does_not_support item; acceptable, not boilerplate. The checker also falls back to an absolute worktree path for locating exact_json when the repo marker is not found; harmless to acceptance but not portable.

earlier_pass.notes: Cold read of specsB/PG-OLD-IMAGE-INJECTIVE.json, old_image_injective_{check,format,semantic,spec}.py, lean4/OldImageInjective.lean (compiled: exit 0, only two dif_pos/dif_neg deprecation warnings at lines 52 and 55), pfp_old_image_injective.py, its test, the Rust module, operads/pg_old_image_injective.yaml and the DAG node. The mathematics is correct and the census numbers I recomputed by hand agree (law = falling factorial * (a+1)^(b-a), e.g. 18 at (2,3), 96 at (3,4); persists = 2^(b-a)(4^a-3^a); cleared = 3^a 2^(b-a) - 2^b). The checker is genuinely independent (closed forms only, no enumeration, no producer import) and recomputes every leaf; the only constants are law_noninjective = 0 (justified by old_image_injective) and the input triple, which is matched against the public cases as a multiset. The problems are in the prose. (1) The converse injective_iff_exists_law is for E = Unit only, but supports files it under 'arbitrary types A, B, E' and narrowest_claim states it without naming E; for E empty, A empty and B nonempty, u is injective and no recovery exists. (2) narrowest_claim says the (|A|+1)^(|B|-|A|) recoveries 'include non-refusing ones'; that is false for |B| = |A| (unique recovery) and for |A| = 0 (the census record (0,3,2) has law_nonrefusing = 0; off_image_not_implied_general needs an old term a0 : A). (3) law_freedom_off_image only produces a recovery that is the same constant x at every off-image point; independent freedom per point is visible only through law_card. (4) observation_not_implied_general does not use the law at all (hypothesis _h is unused): it says that for any lift with A nonempty and two distinct observation values there are q, q' with q' o u != q. 'The law places no constraint on observations' is the right reading only together with observation_preserved_possible, which is in the Lean file but not in the anchors. (5) repair_not_implied_general is Iff.rfl for the identity lift; it says nothing about non-identity lifts. The census columns persists and cleared are not defined in the profile: persists = some a with oA a and oB(u a); cleared = oA nonempty and not persists. 'cleared' is a repair-like notion and sits awkwardly beside the does_not_support disclaimer. All of obs_preserved, persists, cleared are law * (independent factor) by construction (the checker formula shows it), so the census says nothing about the law's effect on them; the Lean statements carry that claim. (6) composition_tree lists recover_after_lift(lift(a)), which is exactly the graft that failed_compositions rejects for a colour mismatch (OldTerm vs NewTerm). Mutants are genuine consistent misreadings and each is caught by the closed forms; I name four missing near misses below. next_test is a real unpaid obligation (a repair criterion), not equal to does_not_support, though it is the means of paying its second item.
